title: FindingsList
description: Array of machine-readable security findings (PG-9). Each entry records one finding with its mitigation status and reference.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description: One security finding identified by ToolFence during the evaluation.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short human-readable description of the finding.

mitigation_status.title: Mitigation Status
mitigation_status.description: Whether the finding has been mitigated.

MitigationRef.title: MitigationRef
MitigationRef.description: Structured reference to the requirement or patch that addresses the finding.

req_id.title: Req Id
req_id.description: Requirement or patch identifier, e.g. "GRD-1" or "PG-3".

description.title: Description
description.description: One-sentence explanation of how the mitigation addresses the finding.
